# AI Engineer Pulse

> Daily AI industry intelligence curated for AI engineers — news, research papers, tools, and infrastructure updates, refreshed every 24 hours.

AI Engineer Pulse (https://aiengineerdaily.vercel.app/) is an automated news dashboard built for AI Engineers, Machine Learning practitioners, and technical readers. It collects, filters, and categorizes AI industry news on a 24-hour cycle, covering LLM engineering, RAG, AI agents, model training, inference, AI infrastructure, MLOps, and multimodal AI.

All news content is free to read and requires no account. An optional email/password account (with a security question for password recovery) unlocks saved items and the Reading List.

- Publisher: amarachinthaakhil — https://www.linkedin.com/in/amarachinthaakhil
- Site language: en-IN
- Category: NewsApplication, developer/AI industry intelligence
- Price: Free (USD 0)
- Update cadence: automated GitHub Action, daily at midnight IST
- Backend: Supabase (auth + data)

## Core Views

- [Today's Overview](https://aiengineerdaily.vercel.app/today): Fresh AI engineering stories from the last 24 hours. Default landing view. Supports full-text search, category filtering, refresh, and light/dark theme.
- [Weekly Overview](https://aiengineerdaily.vercel.app/weekly): The last 7 days of AI news rolled up, for readers who want trends rather than a daily firehose.
- [Briefing](https://aiengineerdaily.vercel.app/briefy): A condensed, narrative digest of the day's most important items — the "read this first" summary.
- [Research](https://aiengineerdaily.vercel.app/research): Research papers and technical publications relevant to practitioners.
- [Tools](https://aiengineerdaily.vercel.app/tools): New and notable AI tooling — frameworks, SDKs, developer utilities, and infrastructure products.
- [Trends](https://aiengineerdaily.vercel.app/trends): Trend visualizations over the aggregated feed, showing which topics are gaining or losing momentum.
- [Reading List](https://aiengineerdaily.vercel.app/reading): A saved-items list for signed-in users.
- [About & FAQ](https://aiengineerdaily.vercel.app/#about): What the site is, what it covers, and how often data refreshes.

## Facts

- Content scope: LLM Engineering, RAG, AI Agents, Model Training, Inference, AI Infrastructure, MLOps, Multimodal AI.
- Data refresh: automated pipeline runs every 24 hours; the UI shows a "stale data" banner when the feed is older than expected.
- Accounts: email + password, plus a security question (first pet / birth city / high school) used for self-service password reset. No social login.
- Built-in chatbot: answers questions about the site's features and can search the day's news.
- No paywall, no ads, no tracking-based personalization described.
- Frontend is a single-page static app (HTML/CSS/JS) with Supabase for auth and data.
